entities.summary: Thomas Dworzak (b. 1972, Bad Kötzting) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bad Kötzting and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, painters & sculptors, europe.
